name: Carlos Escapa
bio: Carlos Escapa spent more than a decade in leadership roles at Amazon Web Services and Meta, building AI ecosystems and industrial alliances. He is co-author of The AI-Driven Business, a lecturer at ESADE, UC Berkeley-Haas and Instituto de Empresa, and currently serves as Executive in Residence at Across Legal. Based between San Francisco and Barcelona, he has trained over four thousand executives on AI strategy.
